title: Embedding a computation run
statement: Let $m\le k$, let $M$ be a machine with $m$ work tapes, Boolean tape alphabet, and state set $S$, and let $H$ be a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean tape alphabet, and state set $B$. Let $\iota:S\to B$ and choose an exceptional state $e\in S$. Suppose that, for every $q\ne e$ and every tuple of scanned input and work-tape symbols, $H$ at state $\iota(q)$ performs the action obtained from $M$ by retaining its tape operations and output, padding the extra work tapes with no operation, and mapping its optional successor state through $\iota$. For any input, initial configuration $c$, and $t\in\mathbb N$, if at every time $j<t$ the run of $M$ from $c$ is in some state different from $e$, then the run of $H$ for $t$ steps from the configuration that maps the states through $\iota$, preserves the first $m$ tapes and heads, and leaves the extra tapes blank at head position zero is the corresponding embedded configuration of the run of $M$ after $t$ steps.
